name: Ambassador
job: Ambassador referral. T+21 fork from WF-06. Referred contact is NEW, never merged. Uses live tag ambassador-referral. Referred contact re-enters WF-01 (which owns the create-once opp).

trigger.notes: Marketing window 08:00-21:00 contact TZ. Referred contact is NEW; never merged with the referrer. Live tag ambassador-referral is not renamed.

named_steps.name: TRIGGER: Added by WF-06 at T+21 (ambassador ask)
named_steps.comment: Asks the member to refer someone. Must not touch the referrer's opportunity.

named_steps.name: SMS: Ambassador invite (inline, first in this sequence)
named_steps.comment: Inline SMS to the referring member. First SMS in this sequence carries Reply STOP to opt out. Members not patients. Marketing window 08:00-21:00 contact TZ.

named_steps.name: IF-ELSE: On ambassador form submitted (referred contact created)
named_steps.comment: Referred contact is created via the ambassador form; must never merge with the referrer.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: ambassador-referral (live tag on referred contact)
named_steps.comment: Live tag. Do not rename ambassador-referral.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: v2_ref_ambassador (referred contact audit)
named_steps.comment: New v2 audit tag on the referred contact.

named_steps.name: ADD-TAG: next-lander (referred contact, so WF-01 enrolls)
named_steps.comment: Live tag next-lander is required by the WF-01 trigger (Contact Created + next-lander). WF-01 owns create-once for the Sales opp. Do not rename next-lander.

named_steps.name: ADD-TO-WF: Referred contact enters WF-01 Lead Capture
named_steps.comment: Referred contact goes through normal Lead Capture. WF-01 owns create-once; do not create a Sales opp here.
